_comment: Every Mysten Labs documentation destination, rendered on /hub and intended to be the single list that also drives the cross-site search tabs and the llms.txt federation. Add a site here, not in three places. Every url is absolute so this list survives being moved to another domain. `llms` is only set where the file was confirmed to return 200; `browsable: false` means the site's own HTML redirects elsewhere, so it is a section for a reader even though its machine-readable endpoints still work.

sites.name: Sui
sites.description: The Sui blockchain: Move development, the CLI, SDKs in context, onchain finance, and node operation.

sites.name: Walrus
sites.description: Decentralized storage for blobs, media, and app data. Also hosts Walrus Sites, Oyster, and Walrus Memory.

sites.name: TypeScript SDKs
sites.description: Reference and guides for the @mysten packages: sui, dapp-kit, walrus, seal, kiosk, bcs, and codegen.

sites.name: The Move Book
sites.description: The Move language reference and book, covering the language itself independently of any one chain.

sites.name: Seal
sites.description: Threshold encryption and onchain access control, with key server operation and access policy patterns.
sites.note: Documented inside the Sui docs. seal-docs.wal.app also resolves and serves its own llms.txt, which is why that file is still listed, but readers are sent to /sui-stack/seal.

sites.name: Enoki
sites.description: zkLogin, sponsored transactions, and wallet infrastructure as a managed service.

sites.name: SuiNS
sites.description: The Sui Name Service: registering names, resolving them, and integrating them into an app.
sites.note: Its HTML pages 301 to docs.sui.io/sui-stack/suins, so for a reader it is a section of the Sui docs. Its .md exports and llms.txt are still served from docs.suins.io and still work, which is why it stays in the machine-readable list.
